prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented after a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change. The reported mechanism is consistent with the type and force of the impact. Imaging and physical examination clearly confirm a fracture of the wrist. No prior injury to the same area is known from the patient's history or records.

Over six visits, care followed a typical course for this injury, including immobilization, pain management, and serial reassessment. Symptoms and function improved steadily, and visit frequency tapered as healing progressed. The patient was discharged from active treatment with ongoing home exercises and instructions to return if symptoms change.

Administrative note: billing records show two similar entries for a single service day. These entries are under routine review and do not alter the clinical findings above.
